title: Position & fix quality
description: Position and receiver-fix information, including satellite count, dilution of precision and height.

fields.name: Fix quality
fields.description: 0 means invalid; other codes identify positioning methods.

fields.name: Satellites used
fields.description: Count used in the solution, not all visible satellites.

fields.name: HDOP
fields.description: Horizontal dilution of precision; a geometry indicator, not an error in meters.

fields.name: Height above MSL
fields.description: Orthometric height referenced to mean sea level.

fields.name: Geoid separation
fields.description: Separation between the geoid and reference ellipsoid.

fields.name: Correction age
fields.description: Age of differential corrections, seconds; may be empty.

notes: GGA does not include a date. Quality codes and extended precision can vary with receiver and version. Height above mean sea level differs from ellipsoidal height.
